_comment: Phase 12 section 4.1: explicit, reviewable Open Images V7 -> PredictiveSense class mapping. Every entry is mapped | unavailable | rejected. Derived from results/external_dataset_audit.json (the actual 5000-image download), never assumed. Nothing here is imported until this file exists and is reviewed.

decisions.reason: Direct, unambiguous correspondence. Ample sample size for a first training proof.

related_rejected_merges.reason_rejected: Tinted/opaque lenses materially change appearance from clear spectacles; merging would blur what our 'spectacles/glasses' recognition target means. Kept as a distinct, unmapped OI class.
A sealed eye-protection object (swimming/lab/sports), not spectacles. Superficially similar name/region, different object. Kept unmapped.

decisions.reason: Both are generic hand-held drinking vessels, matching the single COCO 'cup' primary-tier concept our own Studio class already collapses to (objects/vocab.py has no separate mug/cup distinction). Merging is an accepted approximation that blurs handle-vs-handleless variation in exchange for more combined training data (763 boxes / ~540 images); revisit if the paper later needs the finer distinction.

related_rejected.reason_rejected: Different object (a graduated kitchen tool); also statistically unusable (n=1).

related_rejected_merges.reason_rejected: A distinct large kitchen utensil (typically deeper, used for food prep, not serving/eating) - different typical scale and context from a plain bowl. Kept unmapped rather than merged.

decisions.reason: Exists under a different name than the PS class ('Tin can', not 'Can') - confirmed by reading classes.csv directly rather than assuming absence.

related_rejected.reason_rejected: A different object (a kitchen tool), not a can itself. Zero matches in this download's 5000-image subset regardless.

decisions.reason: Exists under 'Computer keyboard', not bare 'Keyboard' - confirmed by reading classes.csv.

related_rejected.reason_rejected: A musical instrument, not a computer peripheral - wrong meaning despite the shared word. Also too few examples (n=6) regardless.

decisions.reason: 'Mobile phone' matches our cell-phone-shaped 'phone' concept (mirrors COCO's own 'cell phone' primary-tier class).

related_rejected.reason_rejected: A valid OI class in general, but ZERO annotated examples in this specific 5000-image download - unusable regardless of semantics.
Landline handset, semantically distinct from a mobile phone, and statistically unusable in this download (n=4 images).

decisions.reason: Direct correspondence, confirmed present (a plain 'Pen' class does exist in OI-v7's 601-class vocabulary).

No 'Pencil' class exists anywhere in OI-v7's 601-class vocabulary (classes.csv), matching the download tool's own rejection reported by the developer. Only 'Pencil sharpener' (/m/02ddwp, 0 matches in this download) and 'Pencil case' (/m/05676x, 4 boxes/1 image) exist - neither is a proxy for a pencil itself. Studio-data-only; needs our own collection.
No matching class exists anywhere in OI-v7's 601-class vocabulary. Studio-data-only; needs our own collection.

Explicitly rejected, not mapped, per the phase instructions: PredictiveSense's own 'shaker' object is recorded (predictivesense/objects/vocab.py CONFUSABLE_SEEDS) as confusable with can/cylinder/bottle - i.e. a generic cylindrical drink/protein shaker - not a two-piece bartending cocktail tool or a table condiment pair. Mapping either OI class would be mapping to something that merely sounds similar, which the phase instructions explicitly forbid. Also both are near-unusable in this download regardless (n=5 images / n=0). Studio-data-only.

No matching class exists anywhere in OI-v7's 601-class vocabulary (only the unrelated 'Honeycomb', /m/0fz0h). This is the exact class the developer reported as unrecognised - confirms Part A's finding that a Comb classifier can never be trained from this external source; it remains Studio-data-only (currently 2 samples, 1 flagged as a near-duplicate - not enough to train).
